About me

Seven years on the line, one station at a time

I have spent more than seven years cooking in Doha, and I came up the traditional way: from Commis to Demi Chef de Partie to Chef de Partie, learning each step by running it through real service. I started at Karak Mqanes preparing Qatari and fusion dishes, moved into healthy, diet-focused cooking at Seedling, and now lead stations in fine-dining and premium kitchens, including La Parrilla and Oblaka at The Pearl Qatar.

My work is built on tight mise en place, accurate portion control, clean plating and HACCP standards that hold during high-volume service. I like a well-organised station, and I like helping junior cooks find their feet.

I work comfortably in multicultural kitchens and speak Bengali, Arabic, English, Hindi and Urdu, which makes teamwork easier on a busy pass.
